objective_checks.detail: changing docs/guide.md routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing src/index.js routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing package-lock.json routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
changing README.md, LICENSE routes as expected across 3 workflow(s)
required check(s) always fire and gate internally (.github/workflows/tests.yml)
event-only workflows carry no path filters (.github/workflows/nightly-sweep.yml, .github/workflows/triage.yml)

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: Every pull_request/push workflow got a deliberate decision, and the required `unit-tests` check was given the correct single-workflow no-path-filter shape with an inside-the-job computed `run` output gating the real work via `if:`, with no second workflow duplicating the check name.

dimensions.name: Salience
dimensions.rationale: Each workflow's listed paths track what its own steps consume — deploy on src/manifests/deploy.sh, docs-site on docs/mkdocs, tests on src/test/manifests — plus each workflow file itself, rather than catch-alls or copied sibling lists.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The schedule-only nightly-sweep and issue-driven triage workflows and the branch-protection ruleset were left untouched, and the diff edits only the three trigger-bearing workflows the audit called for.
